title: A home held together by affection
literal_meaning: Ah, that home is like Vaikuntha, where mutual affection remains unbroken.
explanation: The verse imagines an ideal home through the affection people show one another. The important word is mutual: care is not demanded from just one person. Its heavenly comparison celebrates a quality of relationships rather than the size or expense of a house.
meaning_odia: ଯେଉଁ ଘରେ ପରସ୍ପର ସ୍ନେହ ରହେ, ସେହି ଘରକୁ ପଦଟି ବୈକୁଣ୍ଠ ସହ ତୁଳନା କରେ। ଘରର ଆକାର ବା ଧନସମ୍ପତ୍ତି ନୁହେଁ, ଲୋକେ ପରସ୍ପରକୁ କିପରି ଆଦର କରନ୍ତି ତାହା ଏଠାରେ ମୁଖ୍ୟ। ସ୍ନେହ ଉଭୟ ପଟୁ ଆସିବା ଦରକାର; ଜଣଙ୍କୁ ସବୁବେଳେ ସହିବାକୁ କହିବା ଏହାର ଅର୍ଥ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Family members share chores and make time to listen during a difficult week; someone says this mutual care is what makes the house a home. (Original imagined occasion.)
cultural_context: Vaikuntha supplies the religious comparison. This is an ideal expressed in verse, not evidence about every household or a reason to remain in a harmful relationship. No original author or work is identified by the captured entry.
odia_summary: ପରସ୍ପର ସ୍ନେହ ହିଁ ଘରକୁ ସୁନ୍ଦର କରେ; ପଦଟି ସେହି ଘରକୁ ବୈକୁଣ୍ଠ ସହ ତୁଳନା କରିଛି।
english_summary: Mutual affection, rather than a grand building, makes the verse’s ideal home.
odia:
ବୈକୁଣ୍ଠ ସମାନ ଆହା ଅଟେ ସେହି ଘର, 
 ପରସ୍ପର ସ୍ନେହ ଯହିଁ ଥାଏ ନିରନ୍ତର ।
